name: slide-builder
description: Slide Builder. Workspaces: app/ (the browser app, built into helper/slide_builder.html) and core/ (pure TypeScript, no DOM). The helper (helper/) is Python, standard library only.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w core && npm run typecheck -w app
scripts.check: npm run check -w core && npm run check -w app
scripts.test: npm run test -w core && npm run test -w app
scripts.bench: npm run bench -w core && npm run bench -w app && node tools/bench.mjs --json bench-results.json
